biology: Host plant recorded as the Chinese chestnut.
distribution: Langhekou, northern slope of the Daba Mountains, Zhenping, Shaanxi.
soldier: Head and antennae brown, the nasus and the anterior margin of the pronotum also darker, the abdominal segments pale. Similar in body form to the large soldier but slightly paler; the anterior margin of the pronotum shows almost no concavity in the middle, while the posterior margin is slightly concave there; mandibles short and small, the tooth-like processes indistinct.
taxonomy_note: The original work placed it in the genus Mironasutitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Nasutitermes.
